title: The Broken Code
cn: 第 4 集 · 破碎的准则
novel:
Barney was [[angry|angry]] at Ted because he discovered that Ted still had feelings for Robin. He felt that Ted had broken the [[code|code]] of [[friendship|friendship]]. According to this unwritten code, a friend should never have romantic feelings for his best friend's wife.

Barney tried to [[discuss|discuss]] the issue with Ted, but the conversation quickly turned into an argument. Ted [[apologized|apologize]] and explained that he could not control his emotions. He promised that he would never act on those feelings.

Meanwhile, Marshall [[joined|join]] the wedding events through a video call. He had been [[appointed|appoint]] as a judge recently, and he could not leave Minnesota yet. He watched the events on his computer screen and tried to participate as much as possible.

Lily [[realized|realize]] something important during the weekend. She noticed that Robin did not have any close female friends. In fact, Lily was Robin's [[only|only]] girlfriend. This made Lily feel special, but also a little [[guilty|guilty]] because she had not been as close to Robin as she should have been.

Barney eventually decided to [[forgive|forgive]] Ted. He understood that Ted was trying his best to [[behave|behave]] properly. The two friends shook hands and agreed to put the issue behind them.

Robin was [[relieved|relieve]] that the conflict was over. She told Barney that she loved him and only him. The group came together again, ready to face the rest of the wedding weekend as a united team. Ted felt [[honest|honest]] about his feelings for the first time.
